units.source_text: 《十六岁的日记》是在大正十四年我二十七岁的时候发表的。

en.t: Sixteen-Year-Old Diary was published in Taisho 14, when I was twenty-seven years old.

units.source_text: 这是大正三年我十六岁那年五月记的日记。

en.t: This is the diary I kept in May of Taisho 3, the year I was sixteen.

units.source_text: 这些日记在我发表的作品中是最早写就的。

en.t: Among the works I have published, these diary entries were the earliest to be written.

units.source_text: 因此在全集里，我把它放在卷首。

en.t: For that reason, in the collected works I placed it at the beginning of the volume.

units.source_text: （所谓十六岁是虚岁，论周岁则是十四岁。）

en.t: The so-called age of sixteen is by traditional East Asian age reckoning; by full years, I was fourteen.
